frames.explanation: Across the top, from left to right, are input → algorithm → output. A note above the algorithm says that its sequence of instructions transforms input into output. Below is the data structure, described as providing structured storage and operations on the data. Three arrows point upward from it to the input, algorithm, and output. It supports all three stages, beyond simply storing the input at the start.
frames.title: How data structures and algorithms work together

summary: Two levels show how an algorithm processes data and how a data structure supports the whole process.
title: How data structures and algorithms work together
